description: This file defines the ProcessGroupWrapper class in the c10d namespace, which wraps around a backend process group for distributed communication in PyTorch. It declares various collective communication methods such as broadcast, allreduce, gather, scatter, and more, for managing distributed tensor operations, specifically with support for Gloo backend. The class also manages internal state related to the backend processes and includes methods for starting and ending coalescing operations.

classes.name: ProcessGroupWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class for distributed process groups, managing collective operations and underlying backend process group interactions, specifically implementing the Gloo backend functionalities.
